auditor.role: read-only chain-of-evidence verifier; not probe author

scope: Byte-level and structural review of the frozen three-row MathGloss/Wikidata capability probe. No HTTP request, semantic source review, equivalence judgment, import, or population estimate was performed.

checks.note: Pinned CSV and probe artifact hashes/sizes agree with the frozen records.
Independent CSV parsing and Unicode tuple sorting reproduce all three selected minima, logical records, physical lines, and six fields.
Each selected property-target pair has exactly one matching statement; statement IDs, types, normal ranks, mainsnaks, and entity revision fields agree with the preserved raw response.
The P460 P518 qualifier order and snak content are faithfully normalised; P279 and P1889 have no qualifier fields in the raw matching statements and are normalised to empty lists.

All three raw matching statements omit the references key; findings.json normalises that omission to references: []. The zero-reference observation is faithful, but it is not literal preservation of a returned reference container.

The probe implements the prior review recommendation to retain full current statement metadata and raw bytes for a bounded candidate layer, and it keeps the rows unreviewed external assertions without semantic promotion.

required_wording_correction.finding: findings.json old_export_comparison.current_api_capability says this response carries complete qualifier/reference containers. For these exact matches, the raw response omits references on all three and omits qualifiers on two; findings.json creates empty lists and renames/flattens keys.
required_wording_correction.recommended_wording: The preserved response carries exact statement IDs and ranks, the P460 qualifier structure, and statement-level omission of qualifier/reference fields where none were returned. findings.json provides a documented normalised view; the raw-response hash remains the exact representation.
required_wording_correction.impact: No selected row, statement ID, rank, qualifier value, or conclusion that zero references were observed changes. This only prevents a false literal-preservation claim.

transport_accounting_scope: command-log.json records one ordinary request and no replacement request, consistent with one raw response file. This audit did not observe the live transport and does not independently certify request count.
claims_supported: The three chosen CSV rows are deterministic within their frozen property strata and endpoint-join rule.
The frozen API response contains one current matching normal-rank statement for each selected source/property/target triple.
The preserved raw response makes statement identity, rank, P460 qualifier content, and entity revision metadata available beyond the six-column CSV.
No references were present on the three matching statements in this response.
claims_not_supported: truth or mathematical correctness of any relation
persistence, completeness, import accuracy, or population rates
quality of sources behind Wikidata statements
literal structural identity between raw statements and the normalised findings objects
